scope: Observe an already issued native return after driver death through existing FSM and cleanup
implementation: Native-return request uses original recorded goal, original reply deadline and surviving local commander; requires actual live current driving FSM even when invoked from cleanup. No additional return doMove.

Exact cap custody constrains speed to zero; original-goal ACK plus measured rest convert to FINAL, clear only completed return/release flags and preserve original hard deadline, anchor, baseline and spent allowances. Existing seat executor must still confirm replacement.

Cleanup offers casualty-return observation before split/deleted-driver classification and dead-driver native classifier. A pending or changed journal returns false to prevent general release; existing ticket signature then observes the changed proof and retires obsolete tickets.
Other crew STOP remains a veto; commander STOP is accepted only as the exact recorded pending/issued phase, never as arbitrary forward consent. Expired or changed replies remain terminal.
